reviews.text:
Very pleased with this clinic. Prices are very fair. Service is excellent!

Our first appt after adoption, siblings Beau & Juno were mostly cooperative with nail trimming and shots (used Churru as positive reinforcement.)

We had their health records and they were due for shots. The doctor was thorough and caring, even noted their good health condition.

I highly recommend Tanglewilde Clinic.

Tanglewilde Veterinary Clinic is wonderful! I’ve taken Lola, Eddy, and Benji there for blood work, vaccinations, and regular care. Dr. Parkerson and the entire team are kind, caring, and welcoming. I always feel my fur babies are in good hands. ❤️

Outstanding Veterinary Medical Services to my Exotic Shorthair.  Bobby Joe my little one is always seen promptly in the smaller clinic setting with excellent Vets and support staff.  I’ve gone to this clinic with my exotics for many years.  I recommend Tanglewilde Clinic always!

We are so pleased with Tanglewilde Veterinary Clinic. Moved here from another clinic. The office staff is very organized and so kind, plus we have never had to wait at all. Dr Frank is so caring and gentle with our 2 cats. She always finds a solution for whatever problem they have and my cats seem so calm with her and the tech that is with her.
Another Tech Dana, told me to bring Luke in the next morning to trim his nails because he doesn’t like anyone to touch his paws. She sedated him which I cannot do (he bites) and called me later to pick him up. It worked so well and he was not stressed and they were done!!
Anyway, this is a wonderful place to bring your fur babies. And the price is very reasonable ! I’ve had to bring both cats in several times for vaccines, nail trims, over grooming problem, weight , checkups .
Thank you everyone at Tanglewilde Vet Clinic
Linda Carlson

I absolutely love this clinic! I had been going to Banfield for years and was very unhappy with my service and the plans. I recently moved over to Tanglewilde Vet Clinic and I have been so happy with the change. They have such a personal touch and make you feel like you're their only customer. When my dog got sick, they took excellent care of her and showed me a lot of empathy during a hard time. After she passed, they sent me such a thoughtful card and checked in on me to see how I was doing. They truly care about your pet and they're an extremely professional group. They are truly excellent! 15/10 recommend!

Absolute best vet clinic in town and its not even close. Knowledgeable, patient, and extremely efficient practice that takes the absolute best care of their customers - two and four legged! My pup is an almost 100 lb certified vet hater (due to previous bad experiences) and the doctors and techs here take such good care of him every time.

I had a very sick cat and was very worried. My normal vet was not open after 12 pm and could not get him in for an emergency visit. Someone at work recommended This Clinic and I am so happy that I went there. Harry was taken care of within two hours and they Handled him with Such loving care. I felt like we had been there many times, even though it was our first time the staff there is just amazing. I will continue to go to this clinic from now on for Harry. And as far as the cost, all of my options were given to me and explained very clearly the steps that we needed to take right then and maybe for the future. I found them to be very reasonable. And Harry went home with medication and is now doing great!
Thank you again, ladies for taking such good care of my sweet Harry!

Great staff.  Val treated my RiverGirl like she was royalty. Dr. Frank was thorough and offered several options for what may be a tough situation.  Her respect and interest made us comfortable.
We are so happy to be new clients

Without a doubt, the best vet visit I’ve ever had. Today I had a bit of a scare with my dog Max. I called the clinic where I usually take him, and they told me they couldn’t see him because they were fully booked with appointments—which I understand—but it still made me feel very sad and worried knowing I couldn’t take him to get checked. So I did some research and called Tanglewilde Veterinary Clinic. They answered very quickly and told me, “Of course, come in—we’ll take care of you.” They literally helped within two hours, the entire team was kind and explained every detail to me.
Dr. Frank was incredibly gentle and caring with my dog!

We always have a great experience when visiting Tanglewilde. Dr. Parkerson has taken care of my chihuahua & cat for a few years now. The staff is fantastic and always makes us feel welcome.  During check ups, the techs always make my fur babies feel safe and do their best to keep them calm throughout their visit. I recommend this clinic to anyone looking for excellent care of their pets.

​Finding a vet you can actually trust is incredibly difficult, and after some poor experiences elsewhere over the years, I became very selective about who I’d let care for my furbabies. Dr. Frank is truly exceptional and has completely earned my confidence. The entire staff has. Each of them are just the kindest people. My dog has had her paw broken before by a groomer elsewhere and has a horrible time letting anyone clip her nails now. The staff here actually sang to my dog and held her (like a hug, not forceful) to calm her down while they clipped her nails. Ive never seen my dog so calm getting a nail trim in her life. This was over a year ago now and I still think about how kind it was.
​She has now seen all three of our pets—our dog and two cats—and her expertise and bedside manner are unmatched. I even take my mothers cat here for her and its not even remotely on the way. She takes the time to listen to my concerns and never makes us feel rushed, which is so rare to find. Even with three very different personalities among my pets, she handles each of them with such patience and genuine care. If you are as particular about your pets health and happiness as I am, Dr. Frank is wonderful. We are very glad to have found this clinic.

I couldn’t ask for a better partner in my dog’s health journey!  Dr Parkerson and Dr Frank are top notch and the entire staff is amazing.  As soon as my car pulls up, my dog’s tail starts wagging with joy.  That’s a pure testimony, for certain!

For the past 11 years, Dr. Parkerson has cared for my two dogs, three cats, and numerous stray kittens, and I cannot recommend her highly enough. During a few frightening moments with some of my pets, both Dr. Parkerson and Dr. Frank provided clarity and reassurance. The entire team at Tanglewilde Veterinary Clinic consistently treats me and my pets with kindness, compassion, and support. They now offer wellness plans that include unlimited visits—an excellent option I strongly encourage you to take advantage of! I feel truly blessed and give thanks to God every time my pets and I visit the clinic.

Very happy with the service and staff. Super friendly, and sweet to our dogs. They seem very knowledgeable. Raven has a small bump on her foot, they tested it and gave us ointment. We wrapped it so she wouldn’t lick the medicine off.

Our recent visit was just for a leptospirosis booster but we have been visiting this vet for many years with the several dogs we have had over those years.  We are always seen promptly and the staff and vets are always kind and attentive to our pet’s needs, even when the pet is less than cooperative.  Highly recommend.
I’ve been taking my rescue pup here for 10 years and have always been happy. They answer all my questions and treat my girl with love and care.

Everyone at Tanglewilde Veterinary Clinic is wonderful. The front desk and vet techs are so friendly and personable, the office is clean and well kept, and the vets are very knowledgeable. We are so happy to take our sweet little Toast to see them for his puppy care needs!
I♥️ Tanglewilde Vets, there’s never a long wait time. All the vets and front desk staff are kind and gracious!! Been going to them for years and will continue to do so!

My pets always get great care here. I usually use Dr Parkerson but have happily seen the other vets too. They are all knowledgeable and great with handling my dogs. The staff is super helpful and responsive too.

Great local vet if you live nearby Westchase area. Great professionals. Easy to get appointment and they truly work with you as partners for your pet health. I recommend.
👍
